reason: Chutney is an everyday staple, so waiting 2 to 3 days for an online delivery doesn't fit my morning routine when my local kirana has sauces instantly.
objection: Why order online and wait days for a 100g tube when I can pick up condiments right downstairs or carry homemade chutney?
would_change_my_mind: Immediate availability on Blinkit or Zepto within 10 minutes.
